# Dentivo

> Dentivo is a SaaS platform built for dental laboratories to manage their day-to-day
> financial and production operations.

## What it is
Dentivo helps dental labs track doctor accounts, supplies, and payments in one place,
and generate printable warranty cards for prosthetic and tooth work delivered to clients.

## Who it's for
Dental laboratories and lab administrators who need to manage doctor billing relationships
and produce warranty documentation for prosthetic/dental work.

## Key features
- Doctor ledger & billing: track balances, payments, and transaction history per doctor
- Warranty card generation: create printable warranty cards for prosthetic/tooth work
- Supply and payment tracking across doctor accounts
- Multi-lab support with role-based access

## Pricing
Contact the Dentivo team for current plans and pricing.
